items.name: use-flash
items.title: useFlash
items.description: React hook that consumes the flash of a createFlash instance after mount and on every client navigation, once per flash.

items.name: flash-toaster
items.title: FlashToaster
items.description: Surfaces the flashes of a createFlash instance through Sonner toasts. Takes the instance as a prop.

items.name: flash-middleware
items.title: flashMiddleware
items.description: Next.js middleware that verifies and consumes the flash cookie server-side, hands it to Server Components, and optionally moves URL flashes into a cookie.
